stem:
The elements in Group 2 show trends in their properties that are typical of metals.
The elements in Group 17 show trends in their properties that are typical of non-metals.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State and explain the trend in ionisation energy down Group 2.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: State and explain the trend in melting point down Group 17.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
The melting point decreases down Group 2.

Explain this trend.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem:
Some reactions based on the Group 2 metal barium, $\text{Ba}$, are shown.

{{figure:diagram_barium_reactions.png}}
parts.text: State the reagent needed for each of reactions 1 and 2.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Name $\mathbf{X}$ and write an equation for its formation.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text:
The $\text{Ba(NO}_3\text{)}_2\text{(aq)}$, produced by reaction 1, is heated to dryness. The anhydrous solid is then heated strongly and decomposes. Barium oxide is produced, together with two other products.

Identify the **two** other products of this decomposition reaction and state what would be observed.

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text: State what would be observed when excess $\text{MgSO}_4\text{(aq)}$ is added to the $\text{Ba(OH)}_2\text{(aq)}$ produced in reaction 2. Explain your answer.
